test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Pianos are Guitars.

Some Guitars are Violins.

No Violins are Drums.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Drums are Guitars.

(II) Some Violins are Pianos.
solution:
**Statements:**

1. All Pianos are Guitars.

2. Some Guitars are Violins.

3. No Violins are Drums.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed9a78dd1b7a5c3763e6b55395a36d47c2442e2f55bd1a47824ae44259829176.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Drums are Guitars: **Does not follow **(Because, No relation is given between Drums and Guitars. So, we cannot say that some Drums are Guitars.)

(II) Some Violins are Pianos: Does not follow (Because, All Pianos are Guitars and Some Guitars are Violins. But it is not necessary that the Guitars which are Violins are also Pianos.So, no definite relation exists between Violins and Pianos.)

So, Neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".**
